briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies compute race as China accelerates domestic models

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while regulatory scrutiny on export controls tightened. US-China decoupling in advanced chips is reshaping supply chains and accelerating parallel ecosystems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 4x context length; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind previewed Gemini 3, Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B, while xAI and DeepSeek pushed new inference-optimized variants.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced three new 100k H100 clusters in Texas; TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips. Saudi Arabia committed $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced AI chips successfully slow China's frontier progress or merely accelerate indigenous alternatives?
